name: Assess Learning Gaps
summary: Run an adaptive assessment and turn evidenced gaps into a learning plan.
description: Assess a learner with adaptive questions tied to their mission, record evidence and calibration, and update a focused learning plan. Use when the user asks to gauge knowledge or identify what to learn next.
risk_reason: This skill runs an adaptive assessment and turn evidenced gaps into a learning plan; it does not flatter, shame, or use hidden grading criteria.
refuses: It does not infer intelligence, employability, or broad competence from a short quiz.
It does not flatter, shame, or use hidden grading criteria.
It does not store verbatim answers or personal assessments without consent.

operational.latency_reason: The skill runs an adaptive assessment and turn evidenced gaps into a learning plan, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
